h1: Grayton Beach "Grayt Dreams" 158 Grayton Village Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool can be heated for an additional fee of $35/day from Oct.1 -Mar. 1- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Elevator- Game room- Wedding & Large Group Event-friendly- 11 adult bikes- Short walk to the Grayton Central Lot complimentary beach shuttle - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled in the heart of Grayton Beach, Grayt Dreams exudes charm and elegance, offering guests a spacious escape along the Emerald Coast. With 4,235 square feet of living space, this home sleeps up to 32 guests across 11 bedrooms and 9 bathrooms—perfect for corporate events, family reunions, bachelorette parties, weddings, and more. Guests can start their day with fresh pastries from Black Bear Bread Co., kayak on Western Lake, or venture to the beach—only a 6-minute drive away!Designed for entertaining, the backyard boasts a refreshing 3-foot-deep pool lined with loungers for soaking in the Florida sun. A screened-in patio invites barbecue dinners, with a natural gas grill and beverage cooler, as well as options for alfresco dining at the 6-seat table or 2-person bistro set. The fun continues in the first-floor game room with a pool table and 75” TV for movie nights. Late-night laughs abound in the bunk room, featuring 2 full-over-full beds, a TV, and convenient access to a shared bathroom with a stacked washer and dryer. Luggage is no problem in this 4-story retreat—simply use the in-home elevator. Bathed in natural light, the second-floor living area serves as the heart of the home, boasting an oversized sectional and 75” TV. Plus, an attached sitting area with a TV that’s perfect for breaking into groups or hosting kids separately. The galley kitchen is equipped with high-end LG appliances, including 2 ovens, 2 refrigerators, 2 dishwashers, 2 microwaves, and even a TV. An expansive table with remarkable length comfortably seats 28 guests together. A stacked washer and dryer add convenience to this floor. Sleep well on the third floor in 4 comfortable guest bedrooms—3 with private bathrooms—each with a king bed and TV, alongside 1 cozy bunk room with a full-over-full bed.On the fourth floor are 4 more guest bedrooms—3 with private bathrooms—each with a king bed and TV. There’s also 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bed.Enjoy a Grayton Beach getaway at Grayt Dream! Exploring is easy with on-site parking for 6 vehicles, 11 bikes, and a low speed vehicle. Take advantage of the free "Grayton Central" parking and shuttle service to the beach—only 2 blocks away. Need more room? Book both Grayt Dream and Graytness next door to host up to 64 guests for large weddings or events. Book Grayt Dreams today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 32):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Game Room with Pool TableSECOND FLOOR:- Main Living Area: Kitchen, Living Room, Den and Laundry RoomTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Parties, weddings, retreats, or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by management company. Fees apply. *This home is pet-friendly with an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400 plus tax. Limit 2 dogs, not to exceed the weight limit of 50lbs.
